title: Pin SpecSync 6.0.0-rc.12 as the Trust 1.2.0-rc.4 contract toolchain
description: Pin SpecSync 6.0.0-rc.12 as the Trust 1.2.0-rc.4 contract toolchain
acceptance_criteria: Trust 1.2.0-rc.4 pins SpecSync 6.0.0-rc.12 as the composite-action default and nested immutable action tag object 29392630a590c13fcca65bec2a3c0a8f8c9e4081 (peeled commit ac796b8eadd3092283093bbea331ec2d3494b527). action.yml, trust_cli.py, validate.py, release.yml, tests/test.sh, plugin.toml, README, and RELEASING agree on that pin. plugin.toml version is 1.2.0-rc.4 and README installs CorvidLabs/trust@v1.2.0-rc.4. fledge lanes run verify and specsync check --force --strict pass under SpecSync 6.0.0-rc.12. The contract gate still does not enable SpecSync lifecycle-enforce. A 1.2.0-rc.4 tag is a prerelease and cannot move the protected v1 channel.
